this_run.reason_churn_not_computable: Churn/A-A comparison requires >=2 repeats at identical configuration to pair against each other. This run made exactly one repeat of exactly one arm, so there is no within-run pair to compute pairwise leaf-outcome disagreement from. The 77.4% (24/31) leaf accuracy is a single draw, not a delta from anything, per the sweep summary's own anomaly note.

published_aa_floor.rule: Any A/B delta on the gemini path smaller than 11.6 percentage points is within noise and must be reported as noise. The det-path floor is 0.0%; an arm that touches only the det path is not subject to the pooled 11.6% figure.

conclusion.delta_vs_floor: Not judgeable. This run has no repeat structure (1 repeat of 1 arm) and no second arm (oracle+mark blocked by open #28), so there is no within-run churn figure and no A/B delta to compare against the published 11.6% (gemini) / 0.0% (det) floor at all. The floor exists and is available for whoever eventually runs a real paired oracle+mark vs extract+mark comparison, but it has nothing to be compared against from this workspace's data.
